scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && tsc --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm --prefix functions run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix functions run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-genesis --only firestore "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.mts"
scripts.test:integration: npm --prefix functions run build && FIRESTORE_DATABASE_ID=highlevel-genesis APP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5173 firebase emulators:exec --project demo-genesis --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run --config tests/integration/vitest.config.mts"
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix functions run build && FIRESTORE_DATABASE_ID=highlevel-genesis APP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5173 firebase emulators:exec --project demo-genesis --only auth,firestore,functions "playwright test"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && FIRESTORE_DATABASE_ID=highlevel-genesis firebase emulators:start --project demo-genesis --only auth,firestore,functions
